gap_for_weaker.rule: Chemical formulas use real subscript markup (<sub>, or verified U+2080-2089 glyphs) with digits at 60-70% size and lowered at least 0.25 em. Old-style or proportional figures are banned in formulas. The QA glyph test renders H₂O, 2H₂O and H₂O₂ at 1080 width and fails if a subscript bottom sits on the baseline.
